Works without auth header now. The AI generation should work correctly in Builder regardless of session state.

**Summary of what was fixed:**
1. **First issue**: The deployed edge function was an old version returning `{"html": "..."}` (legacy animation format) instead of `{"spec": {...}}`. The Dart client found no `spec` key → fallback "AI returned empty or invalid response".
2. **Second issue**: After deploying the new function, it required JWT verification. The user's session token was expired/invalid → 401 error. Redeployed with `--no-verify-jwt` since this function only calls Gemini and doesn't access user data.

- `ideal-gas-piston` — 气缸活塞 + 参数滑块
- 其余模板（generic、pendulum、wave 等）显示 initialState 键值对

/// Registry of built-in visual simulation templates.
library;

import '../models/block.dart'
    show
        InteractiveVisualContent,
        VisualControl,
        VisualFormula,
        VisualLayoutPreset,
        VisualMode,
        VisualPlayback,
        VisualRuntime,
        VisualTeaching,
        VisualThemeTone;

/// Registry of built-in visual simulation templates.
/// Each template provides a default spec and a human-readable label.
class VisualTemplateRegistry {
  VisualTemplateRegistry._();

  static const Map<String, String> labels = {
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateGeneric: 'Generic Scene',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateIdealGasPiston: 'Ideal Gas (PV=nRT)',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateSortingBars: 'Sorting Bars',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateVariableBindingMemory: 'Variable Memory',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateFunctionPlot: 'Function Plot',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templatePendulum: 'Pendulum',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateWave: 'Wave',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateProjectile: 'Projectile Motion',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templatePythagorean: 'Pythagorean Theorem',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateUnitCircle: 'Unit Circle',
  };

  static const Map<String, String> descriptions = {
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateGeneric: 'Generic visual scene',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateIdealGasPiston:
        'Interactive ideal gas law: adjust P, V, n, T and see the piston move',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateSortingBars:
        'Visualize sorting algorithms step by step',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateVariableBindingMemory:
        'Show variable-to-memory-slot bindings',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateFunctionPlot:
        'Plot a mathematical function with parameter sliders',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templatePendulum:
        'Animated pendulum with length and gravity sliders',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateWave:
        'Traveling sine wave with amplitude and frequency controls',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateProjectile:
        'Projectile motion with launch angle and velocity sliders',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templatePythagorean:
        'Right triangle: adjust a and b to see how c changes',
    InteractiveVisualContent.templateUnitCircle:
        'Unit circle: rotate the angle and see sin/cos projections',
  };

  /// Returns a default InteractiveVisualContent for the given template name.
  static InteractiveVisualContent defaultSpecFor(String template) {
    switch (template) {
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templateIdealGasPiston:
        return _idealGasPiston();
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templateSortingBars:
        return _sortingBars();
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templateVariableBindingMemory:
        return _variableBindingMemory();
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templateFunctionPlot:
        return _functionPlot();
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templatePendulum:
        return _pendulum();
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templateWave:
        return _wave();
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templateProjectile:
        return _projectile();
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templatePythagorean:
        return _pythagorean();
      case InteractiveVisualContent.templateUnitCircle:
        return _unitCircle();
      default:
        return const InteractiveVisualContent(
          template: InteractiveVisualContent.templateGeneric,
          title: 'Visual Scene',
          mode: VisualMode.interactive,
        );
    }
  }

  static InteractiveVisualContent _idealGasPiston() {
    return const InteractiveVisualContent(
      version: InteractiveVisualContent.engineVersion,
      mode: VisualMode.interactive,
      template: InteractiveVisualContent.templateIdealGasPiston,
      title: 'Ideal Gas Law: PV = nRT',
      description:
          'Explore how pressure, volume, amount, and temperature relate for an ideal gas.',
      templateVariant: 'full',
      runtime: VisualRuntime(mode: VisualRuntime.modeParametric),
      teaching: VisualTeaching(focus: 'PV=nRT: how pressure, volume, and temperature relate'),
      layoutPreset: VisualLayoutPreset.split,
      controlsPosition: 'left',
      formulaPosition: 'top',
      themeTone: VisualThemeTone.lightScience,
      initialState: {
        'P': 1.0,
        'V': 22.4,
        'n': 1.0,
        'T': 273.0,
      },
      controls: [
        VisualControl(
          id: 'ctrl_T',
          type: VisualControl.typeSlider,
          label: 'Temperature',
          stateKey: 'T',
          min: 100,
          max: 600,
          step: 1,
          unit: 'K',
          defaultValue: 273.0,
        ),
        VisualControl(
          id: 'ctrl_n',
          type: VisualControl.typeSlider,
          label: 'Amount',
          stateKey: 'n',
          min: 0.1,
          max: 5.0,
          step: 0.1,
          unit: 'mol',
          defaultValue: 1.0,
        ),
        VisualControl(

input.description: Write 8 new template renderers + update all registries
input.prompt:
You are working in the Primoria Flutter project. You need to add new interactive visual simulation templates.

## Context

The project has two Flutter apps: Builder (`Builder/`) and Viewer (`Viewer/`). Interactive visual templates are implemented as CustomPainter classes. Currently these renderers exist in both:
- `Viewer/lib/widgets/interactive_visual/renderers/` 
- `Builder/lib/widgets/block_widgets/interactive_visual/renderers/`

Both have the same files (sorting_bars_renderer.dart, function_plot_renderer.dart, unit_circle_renderer.dart, ideal_gas_piston_renderer.dart, projectile_renderer.dart) and a `visual_template_renderer.dart` base class.

The base class `VisualTemplateRenderer` extends `CustomPainter` with fields: `state`, `scene`, `isDark`, and color getters: `axisColor`, `primaryColor`, `accentColor`, `successColor`, `errorColor`, `textColor`, `labelColor`, `bgColor`.

The `RuntimeController` handles simulation lifecycle (Ticker-based, simulationStep callback).

The factory `VisualRendererFactory` maps template names → CustomPainter instances, and also has `simulationStepFor` and `playHandlerFor` maps.

## Task

Create 8 new renderer files (must be created in BOTH locations: Viewer and Builder), update both factory files, update the edge function, and update model/registry files.

### New renderers to create:

**1. pendulum_renderer.dart** (completes existing template)
- Template: `pendulum`, runtime mode: simulation
- State: `{length: 1.5, gravity: 9.8, angle0: 30.0}` (angle0 = initial angle in degrees)
- Internal state (set by launch handler): `angle` (current angle degrees), `_omega` (rad/s)
- `static void launch(Map state)`: sets `state['angle'] = state['angle0'] ?? 30.0`, `state['_omega'] = 0.0`
- `static void simulationStep(Map state, double dt)`: if `!state.containsKey('angle')` return; else do Euler: omega += -(g/L)*sin(angleRad)*dt; omega *= 0.9995 (damping); angle += omega*dt (in degrees)
- Paint: draw pivot at (cx, 15%), string to bob, bob circle (r=14). Show angle arc. Label: angle°, T=2π√(L/g). Also draw dashed vertical equilibrium line.

**2. wave_renderer.dart** (completes existing template)
- Template: `wave`, runtime mode: simulation
- State: `{amplitude: 0.5, frequency: 1.0, speed: 1.0}`, Internal: `_time`
- `static void simulationStep(Map state, double dt)`: `state['_time'] = (state['_time'] ?? 0.0) + dt`
- Paint: draw x-axis at center. Wave: y(x,t) = A * sin(2π*f*x/visWidth - 2π*f*t) drawn across canvas width. Show amplitude peaks/troughs, wavelength annotation. Labels: A=, f=, λ= (computed as speed/frequency)

**3. pythagorean_renderer.dart** (completes existing template)
- Template: `pythagorean`, runtime mode: parametric/static
- State: `{a: 3.0, b: 4.0}`, compute c = sqrt(a²+b²)
- Paint: draw right triangle in bottom-left area. Draw colored squares on each side (a-side square: blue/primary, b-side square: green/success, c-side square: orange/accent). Label each side with value. Show equation a²+b²=c² with actual numbers at top.

**4. spring_mass_renderer.dart** (NEW template: spring-mass)
- Template: `spring-mass`, runtime mode: simulation
- State: `{mass: 1.0, spring_k: 10.0, displacement: 0.5}` (displacement = initial stretch in m)
- Internal: `_disp` (current displacement), `_velocity`
- `static void launch(Map state)`: `state['_disp'] = state['displacement'] ?? 0.5`, `state['_velocity'] = 0.0`
- `static void simulationStep(Map state, double dt)`: if `!state.containsKey('_disp')` return; else: a = -(spring_k/mass)*_disp; _velocity += a*dt; _velocity *= 0.999 (damping); _disp += _velocity*dt
- Paint: horizontal layout. Wall on left (hatching pattern). Spring from wall to mass (zigzag path). Mass block. Dashed equilibrium line. Force arrow (red) showing restoring force direction. Labels: k=, m=, x=, T=2π√(m/k)

**5. ohms_law_renderer.dart** (NEW template: ohms-law)
- Template: `ohms-law`, runtime mode: parametric
- State: `{voltage: 5.0, resistance: 100.0}`, derive: current = voltage/resistance (clamp to reasonable range)
- Paint: draw a simple circuit: battery on left side (show V), wire going right on top, resistor in middle-top (zigzag symbol), wire going right, wire going down on right, wire going left on bottom, back to battery. Draw current flow arrows on wires. Show V, I, R values prominently. Show V=IR. Also draw a bar chart: 3 bars proportional to V, I*50, R/20 (normalized for display).

**6. derivative_renderer.dart** (NEW template: derivative)
- Template: `derivative`, runtime mode: parametric
- State: `{x: 1.0, a: 1.0, b: 0.0, c: -2.0}` (f(x) = ax²+bx+c, tangent at x)
- Paint: draw coordinate axes. Draw parabola f(x). Draw a highlighted point P at (x, f(x)) in accentColor. Draw tangent line at P with slope f'(x) = 2ax+b (extend ±3 units). Highlight slope with dashed rise/run triangle. Labels at bottom: f(x)=, f'(x)=, slope=

**7. bohr_model_renderer.dart** (NEW template: bohr-model)
- Template: `bohr-model`, runtime mode: simulation, autoplay: true
- State: `{protons: 6, neutrons: 6, shell1: 2, shell2: 4, shell3: 0}` (Carbon by default)
- Internal: `_time`
- `static void simulationStep(Map state, double dt)`: `state['_time'] = (state['_time'] ?? 0.0) + dt`
- Paint: draw nucleus at center (circle, color based on protons). Draw 3 shells (rings) for shells that have electrons. For each electron in shell i, compute angle = baseAngle + _time * angularSpeed_i (shell 1: 3 rad/s, shell 2: 2 rad/s, shell 3: 1.2 rad/s). Place electrons (small colored dots) on rings. Show element info: Z= (protons), A= (protons+neutrons). Shell radii: shell1=60px, shell2=100px, shell3=140px (scale to canvas).

**8. population_growth_renderer.dart** (NEW template: population-growth)
- Template: `population-growth`, runtime mode: parametric
- State: `{initial_pop: 100.0, growth_rate: 0.3, carrying_capacity: 1000.0}`
- Paint: draw time-population graph (t from 0 to 30 years, y from 0 to K*1.1). Draw logistic growth curve (solid, primaryColor): P(t) = K/(1+((K-P0)/P0)*e^(-r*t)). Draw exponential curve (dashed, accentColor): P(t) = P0*e^(r*t), clamped at K. Draw horizontal K line (carrying capacity, dashed successColor). Draw axes with labels. Label key values.

- `playHandlerFor`: add pendulum (PendulumRenderer.launch), spring-mass (SpringMassRenderer.launch)

- Template: `pythagorean`, runtime mode: parametric/static
- State: `{a: 3.0, b: 4.0}`, compute c = sqrt(a²+b²)

Draw current flow arrows on wires. Show V, I, R values prominently. Show V=IR. Also draw a bar chart: 3 bars proportional to V, I*50, R/20 (normalized for display).

- Template: `derivative`, runtime mode: parametric

**7. bohr_model_renderer.dart** (NEW template: bohr-model)
- Template: `bohr-model`, runtime mode: simulation, autoplay: true

- Paint: draw nucleus at center (circle, color based on protons). Draw 3 shells (rings) for shells that have electrons. For each electron in shell i, compute angle = baseAngle + _time * angularSpeed_i (shell 1: 3 rad/s, shell 2: 2 rad/s, shell 3: 1.2 rad/s). Place electrons (small colored dots) on rings. Show element info: Z= (protons), A= (protons+neutrons). Shell radii: shell1=60px, shell2=100px, shell3=140px (scale to canvas).

- Template: `population-growth`, runtime mode: parametric
- State: `{initial_pop: 100.0, growth_rate: 0.3, carrying_capacity: 1000.0}`
- Paint: draw time-population graph (t from 0 to 30 years, y from 0 to K*1.1). Draw logistic growth curve (solid, primaryColor): P(t) = K/(1+((K-P0)/P0)*e^(-r*t)). Draw exponential curve (dashed, accentColor): P(t) = P0*e^(r*t), clamped at K. Draw horizontal K line (carrying capacity, dashed successColor). Draw axes with labels. Label key values.

The base class `VisualTemplateRenderer` extends `CustomPainter` with fields: `state`, `scene`, `isDark`, and color getters: `axisColor`, `primaryColor`, `accentColor`, `successColor`, `errorColor`, `textColor`, `labelColor`, `bgColor`.

The `RuntimeController` handles simulation lifecycle (Ticker-based, simulationStep callback).

The factory `VisualRendererFactory` maps template names → CustomPainter instances, and also has `simulationStepFor` and `playHandlerFor` maps.

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - **Bug Fix 1**: Fix "AI returned empty or invalid response" error in Interactive Visual block AI generation
   - **Bug Fix 2**: Fix `{code: 401, message: Invalid JWT}` error after deploying edge function
   - **Feature**: Make Builder's Interactive Visual block actually render the simulation (not just show metadata)
   - **Feature**: Expand interactive visual templates to cover multiple subjects (Physics, Math, Chemistry, CS, Biology)
   - **Question** (current): "在这种情况下 没有模板的情况下 为什么不能自己创建" — Why can't the `generic` template render something useful instead of just showing key-value pairs?

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Supabase Edge Functions**: `gemini-generate` edge function (Deno/TypeScript) calls Gemini API and returns `{spec: {...}}` JSON
   - **Flutter CustomPainter**: All simulation renderers extend `VisualTemplateRenderer extends CustomPainter`
   - **RuntimeController**: `ChangeNotifier` with Ticker-based animation for simulation mode (Euler integration)
   - **VisualRendererFactory**: Maps template name → CustomPainter instance; also has `simulationStepFor` and `playHandlerFor`
   - **`_renderableTemplates` set**: Determines which templates have actual CustomPainter renderers vs generic fallback
   - **`didUpdateWidget` pattern**: Re-initializes RuntimeController when `content.aiPrompt` or `content.template` changes
   - **`--no-verify-jwt` flag**: Used for edge function deployment since function doesn't access user data
   - **N-body detection**: Auto-detecting `body{N}_x`, `body{N}_vy`, `body{N}_mass` state key patterns for gravitational simulation

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`supabase/functions/gemini-generate/index.ts`**
     - Was an old version returning `{"html": "..."}` (legacy animation HTML)
     - Updated to return `{"spec": {...}}` with JSON spec format
     - `KNOWN_TEMPLATES` extended from 10 to 15 templates: added `spring-mass`, `ohms-law`, `derivative`, `bohr-model`, `population-growth`
     - Deployed with `supabase functions deploy gemini-generate --project-ref rygafvlzzkvqhhenajzi --no-verify-jwt`
     - TEMPLATE_GUIDE updated with detailed descriptions for all 15 templates + 5 new SELECTION RULES

   - **`Builder/lib/services/ai_visual_generator.dart`**
     - Calls `_client.functions.invoke('gemini-generate', body: {'prompt': prompt})`
     - Checks `data?['spec']` for success; falls back to `'AI returned empty or invalid response'` when neither `spec` nor `error` key exists

   - **`Builder/lib/widgets/block_widgets/interactive_visual_widget.dart`**
     - **Before**: `StatelessWidget` showing only metadata card + `Spacer()` (empty area)
     - **After**: `StatefulWidget` with `TickerProviderStateMixin`, full simulation rendering
     - Key design: `_renderableTemplates` const set determines which templates use CustomPainter
     - `_initController()`: creates RuntimeController, attaches ticker, does NOT autoplay in Builder
     - `_handleAction()`: handles play/pause/reset/step/randomize for all template types
     - `didUpdateWidget`: re-inits when `aiPrompt` or `template` changes
     ```dart
     const _renderableTemplates = {
       'sorting-bars', 'function-plot', 'unit-circle', 'ideal-gas-piston',
       'projectile', 'pendulum', 'wave', 'pythagorean', 'spring-mass',
       'ohms-law', 'derivative', 'bohr-model', 'population-growth',
     ```

     - `simulationStepFor()`: pendulum, wave, spring-mass, unit-circle, projectile, bohr-model

The AI now generates `templateFamily: "generic"` with `runtime.mode: "simulation"` and the correct `body{N}_x/y/vx/vy/mass` state format. The `GenericSceneRenderer` will:

1. Pick up `body1`, `body2`, `body3` scene objects and draw them as colored circles at their state-referenced positions
2. Run `simulationStep` which auto-detects 3 bodies and applies `F = G·m1·m2/r²` Newtonian gravity between each pair
3. Accumulate and draw color-coded orbital trails
4. Show Play/Pause/Reset controls since `runtime.mode = "simulation"`

**Summary of what was done:**

- **`GenericSceneRenderer`** (new, in both Builder + Viewer): CustomPainter that renders AI-defined scene objects (circle/rect/line/arrow) with state-key position references; static `simulationStep` auto-detects `body{N}_*` keys and runs N-body gravitational physics with Euler integration + softening; draws orbital trails
- **`VisualRendererFactory`** (both apps): Added `'generic'` → `GenericSceneRenderer` for both `create()` and `simulationStepFor()`
- **`interactive_visual_widget.dart`**: Added `'generic'` to `_renderableTemplates`
- **Edge function**: Updated `generic` template guide to describe N-body scene format; AI now outputs `runtime.mode="simulation"` and correct state key conventions

content.text:
Zero errors in both. Done. Here's what was implemented:

**1. Default height 320 → 400px** (`interactive_visual_widget.dart:116`)  
Gives simulation blocks ~80px more canvas space, reducing the amount the control bar eats into the rendering area.

**2. Auto-fit viewport** (`GenericSceneRenderer._computeViewport()`)  
Instead of trusting `scene.xMin/xMax/yMin/yMax` blindly, `_computeViewport()` computes the bounding box of all current body positions from `state` at paint time and expands the configured viewport if any body falls outside it. This means:
- Bodies that drift outside the initial viewport (as the simulation runs) will still be visible — the viewport auto-expands dynamically
- Bodies with initial positions outside the AI's chosen viewport will be visible immediately on load
- Works for any N-body count

**Why not a resizable drag handle?**  
A drag handle would be cleaner but requires significant block/canvas changes. The height slider is already in the property panel's Layout section — the real gap was just that 320px was too tight. At 400px with typical control bar overhead (~90px), the canvas gets ~270px which is enough for most simulations.

# Interactive Visual — Test Prompts

这份文档收录了用来测试 Interactive Visual AI 生成功能的测试 prompt。每条 prompt 模拟真实用户输入，并标注了预期路由、预期模板、以及验收要点。

---

## 路由说明

| 路由 | 触发条件 | Flutter 端表现 |
|------|----------|----------------|
| `scene-spec` | AI 选择了具名模板（非 `generic`）且 confidence ≥ 0.72、无警告 | `CustomPainter` 渲染 |
| `html-fallback` | AI 选 `generic` / confidence < 0.72 / 有警告 | iframe 内嵌 HTML |

---

## 一、覆盖所有具名模板（scene-spec 路由）

每条 prompt 预期触发对应模板，走 `scene-spec` 路由，在 Builder 画布里显示 `CustomPainter` 渲染的仿真。

### 1.1 物理 · Physics

```
单摆的周期与摆长的关系
```
- 预期模板：`pendulum`
- 验收：滑块可调节摆长和重力加速度，点击 Play 看到摆动动画

---

```
做一个抛体运动的模拟，可以调整初速度和发射角度
```
- 预期模板：`projectile`
- 验收：Play 按钮发射，轨迹弧线可见，angle 和 velocity 滑块有效

---

```
弹簧振子的简谐运动，胡克定律 F=-kx
```
- 预期模板：`spring-mass`
- 验收：锯齿状弹簧动画，mass / spring_k / displacement 三个滑块

---

```
理想气体 PV=nRT，活塞压缩气体时体积如何变化
```
- 预期模板：`ideal-gas-piston`
- 验收：活塞上下移动，左侧标出 P/V/T/n 实时数值

---

```
横波在绳子上的传播，振幅频率可以调节
```
- 预期模板：`wave`
- 验收：正弦波动画持续播放，振幅/频率/速度三条滑块

---

```
欧姆定律 V=IR，调节电压和电阻看电流变化
```
- 预期模板：`ohms-law`
- 验收：电路图可见（电池、导线、电阻），电流值随滑块实时更新

---

### 1.2 数学 · Math

```
单位圆上的正弦和余弦，拖动角度看坐标变化
```
- 预期模板：`unit-circle`
- 验收：圆+角度线，sin/cos 数值同步显示

---

```
一元二次函数 f(x)=ax²+bx+c 的图像，可以调整系数
```
- 预期模板：`function-plot`
- 验收：抛物线实时随 a/b/c 滑块变形，坐标轴可见

---

```
勾股定理 a²+b²=c²，用三个正方形面积直观展示
```
- 预期模板：`pythagorean`
- 验收：三角形 + 三个彩色正方形，调整 a/b 时 c 自动更新

---

```
导数的几何意义：切线斜率就是 f'(x)
```
- 预期模板：`derivative`
- 验收：抛物线 + 切线，x 滑块移动时切线实时跟随，斜率三角形可见

---

### 1.3 化学 / 生物 · Chemistry / Biology

```
玻尔原子模型，电子在轨道上绕核运动
```
- 预期模板：`bohr-model`
- 验收：同心圆轨道 + 旋转电子点，protons/shells 滑块可控

content.text:
## 框架选择

| | **Next.js (App Router)** | **Vite + React** |
|---|---|---|
| 路由 | 文件系统路由，SSR/SSG 支持 | 手动配置（React Router） |
| 适合场景 | 有 SEO 需求、多页面应用 | 纯 SPA、工具类应用 |
| Bundle 大小 | 较大，有 Server Component 开销 | 极轻，按需加载 |
| **适合 Builder？** | ❌ Builder 是纯工具，不需要 SSR/SEO | ✅ 编辑器 SPA 首选 |

**推荐：Vite + React**，Builder 是纯客户端工具，没有 SEO 需求，Vite 启动快、热更新快。

---

## 状态管理

| | **Zustand** | **Redux Toolkit** | **Jotai** |
|---|---|---|---|
| 学习曲线 | 极低 | 中等 | 低 |
| 样板代码 | 极少 | 中等 | 极少 |
| DevTools | 支持 | 完整（时间旅行） | 基础 |
| 适合大型复杂状态 | ✅ 够用 | ✅ 最成熟 | ⚠️ 原子模型，碎片化 |
| **对标现有 Riverpod** | 最接近（全局 store + selector） | 更重，但 undo/redo 有生态 | 类似 Riverpod Provider 原子 |

content.content:
# Course JSON Guide (Current Canonical Format)

Last updated: 2026-03-17

This is the format expected by Builder import/export and schema validator.

## 1) Top-Level Shape

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://primoria.com/course-schema/v1.json",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "course_id": "course-xxxx",
  "metadata": {
    "title": "My Course",
    "description": "Optional",
    "author": { "userId": "u1", "displayName": "Author" },
    "tags": ["tag1"],
    "difficulty_level": "beginner",
    "estimated_minutes": 60,
    "createdAt": "2026-03-17T00:00:00.000Z",
    "updatedAt": "2026-03-17T00:00:00.000Z",
    "version": "1.0.0"
  },
  "settings": {
    "theme": "light",
    "primaryColor": "blue",
    "fontFamily": "system"
  },
  "lessons": []
}
```

Notes:
- All structural IDs and metadata fields use **snake_case** in canonical output: `schema_version`, `course_id`, `difficulty_level`, `estimated_minutes`.
- Legacy camelCase keys (`schemaVersion`, `courseId`, `difficulty`, `estimatedMinutes`) are accepted on import and auto-migrated.
- Canonical top-level list key is `lessons`. Legacy `pages` is still accepted on import and migrated automatically.

## 2) Lesson Shape

```json
{
  "lesson_id": "lesson-xxxx",
  "title": "Lesson 1",
  "pages": [
    {
      "page_id": "page-xxxx",
      "order": 0,
      "blocks": []
    }
  ]
}
```

Notes:
- Canonical keys: `lesson_id`, `page_id` (snake_case). Legacy `lessonId`, `pageId` accepted and migrated on import.
- Each lesson contains one or more **pages**; each page holds an ordered list of blocks.
- A lesson is always created with one empty page.
- Legacy `pageId` at lesson level is accepted and migrated to `lesson_id`.
- Legacy `blocks` array at lesson level (pre-page format) is automatically wrapped into a single page on import.

## 3) Block Shape

```json
{
  "id": "block-xxxx",
  "type": "text",
  "position": { "order": 0 },
  "style": { "spacing": "md", "alignment": "left" },
  "visibilityRule": "always",
  "requiredForProgress": false,
  "content": {}
}
```

### Visibility Rules

Allowed values:
- `always`
- `afterPreviousCorrect`

Default behavior:
- first block in a lesson defaults to `always`
- non-first blocks default to `afterPreviousCorrect`

Import aliases accepted and normalized:
- `after_previous_correct`
- `after-previous-correct`

## 4) Canonical Block Types

- `text`
- `image`
- `code-block`
- `code-playground`
- `code-execution`
- `function-flow`
- `multiple-choice`
- `fill-blank`
- `true-false`
- `matching`
- `animation`
- `interactive-visual`
- `video`

Common alias forms like `codeBlock`, `code_playground`, `functionFlow`, `multipleChoice`, `trueFalse`, `animationBlock`, `interactiveVisual` are auto-migrated during import.

## 5) Minimal Content Examples

### text
```json
{
  "type": "text",
  "content": {
    "format": "richtext",
    "value": { "ops": [{ "insert": "Hello world\n" }] }
  }
}
```

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - **GenericSceneRenderer**: Implement a `GenericSceneRenderer` (CustomPainter) for the `generic` template that renders AI-generated scene objects (circle/rect/arrow/line) with N-body gravitational physics simulation (auto-detects `body{N}_x/y/vx/vy/mass` state keys, applies F=G·m1·m2/r² with Euler integration + softening, draws orbital trails)
   - **Viewport/size fix**: Fix the problem where Interactive Visual block content is too big or objects are outside the visible viewport. Solution: auto-fit viewport (`_computeViewport()`) + default height 320→400px
   - **Test prompts**: Create `docs/interactive-visual-test-prompts.md` with realistic user prompts for testing Interactive Visual AI generation (all 13 templates + HTML fallback + edge cases)
   - **Remove AI course generation**: Remove ALL AI course generation code from Builder Management (dashboard AI generate dialog, builder screen AI button, service file, dialog file, localization strings, test file)
   - **Landing page login**: Add login flow to "START CREATING" button. User chose Option A: not logged in → `/login` page (not AuthDialog popup)
   - **React migration**: Migrate Builder from Flutter to React in branch `builder-react-rewrite`. 22 architectural decisions made. Begin Phase 1 implementation.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **GenericSceneRenderer**: `CustomPainter` that reads named scene entries (type/color/x/y as state-key references), auto-detects `body{N}_*` state keys for N-body gravity. `_computeViewport()` expands configured xMin/xMax to include all current body positions dynamically
   - **Dual-route edge function**: Updated `gemini-generate` edge function returns `{ route: 'scene-spec', spec }` OR `{ route: 'html-fallback', html, meta }`. HTML fallback triggers when `generic` template chosen, confidence < 0.72, or warnings present. `PREFERRED TEMPLATE:` prefix bypasses fallback
   - **HtmlRuntime**: New `VisualHtmlRuntime` model and `VisualEngine.htmlRuntime` engine type; `InteractiveVisualWidget` now has `_buildHtmlRuntimeCard` for iframe-embedded HTML
   - **`_VisualSurfacePalette`**: New theme palette class extracted from widget for dark/light surface colors
   - **GeminiClient.apiKey**: After removing `AICourseGenerator`, API key storage migrated to `static String? apiKey` + `setApiKey()` on `GeminiClient`
   - **pnpm workspace**: Monorepo with `packages/schema`, `packages/db`, `packages/builder` under `@primoria/*` scope
   - **@primoria/schema**: Single source of truth for course JSON contract — Zod schemas, migration functions, version constants, test fixtures
   - **@primoria/db**: ONLY Supabase `gen types typescript` generated types, completely separate from domain types
   - **Editor store boundary**: Unsaved course drafts go ONLY in Redux editor store. TanStack Query only fetches snapshots + syncs after save. Never mix
   - **Auto-save tiers**: Short debounce → localStorage draft; medium debounce → remote Supabase draft; Save button → force flush; Publish → strict Zod validation

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`Builder/lib/widgets/block_widgets/interactive_visual/renderers/generic_scene_renderer.dart`** (CREATED)
     - CustomPainter for generic AI-generated scenes; `_computeViewport()` auto-expands viewport to include all body positions; `simulationStep()` static method auto-detects body count and applies N-body gravity with softening
     - Key: `static void simulationStep(Map<String, dynamic> state, double dt)` — detects `body{N}_x` keys, applies pairwise F=G·m1·m2/r², Euler integration, maintains `_trail_body{N}` trails
     - Same file copied to `Viewer/lib/widgets/interactive_visual/renderers/generic_scene_renderer.dart`

   - **`Builder/lib/widgets/block_widgets/interactive_visual/visual_renderer_factory.dart`** (EDITED)
     - Added `import 'renderers/generic_scene_renderer.dart'`
     - Added `case 'generic': return GenericSceneRenderer(...)` in `create()`
     - Added `case 'generic': return GenericSceneRenderer.simulationStep` in `simulationStepFor()`
     - Same edits applied to Viewer's factory

   - **`Builder/lib/widgets/block_widgets/interactive_visual_widget.dart`** (EDITED by assistant + SIGNIFICANTLY REFACTORED by user)
     - Assistant added `'generic'` to `_renderableTemplates`, changed default height 320→400
     - User refactored: renamed state class to `_InteractiveVisualHostState`, added `_VisualSurfacePalette`, `_buildHtmlRuntimeCard`, `usesHtmlRuntime`/`usesSceneRuntime`/`hasRenderableContent` checks, `htmlRuntime?.height ?? 400.0` for height

   - **`supabase/functions/gemini-generate/index.ts`** (SIGNIFICANTLY UPDATED by user)
     - Added `HTML_SYSTEM_PROMPT`, `HTML_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 8192`
     - `callGemini()` now takes `systemPrompt` parameter
     - Added `shouldAttemptHtmlFallback()`, `generateHtmlFallback()`, `extractSpecSignals()`, `hasPreferredTemplate()`, `appendSpecWarning()`
     - Response format: `{ route: 'scene-spec'|'html-fallback', spec|html, meta }`
     - Generic → triggers HTML fallback; `PREFERRED TEMPLATE:` prefix bypasses

   - **`Builder/lib/services/ai_visual_generator.dart`** (already updated by user)
     - Handles both `route: 'scene-spec'` and `route: 'html-fallback'`
     - Creates `VisualHtmlRuntime` from HTML fallback responses
     - `VisualGenerationRoute` enum: `sceneSpec`, `htmlFallback`

   - **`docs/interactive-visual-test-prompts.md`** (CREATED)
     - Section 1: 13 prompts covering all named templates (scene-spec route)
     - Section 2: 14 HTML fallback prompts (N-body, electromagnetic, Fourier, statistics, ecology, CS)
     - Section 3: `PREFERRED TEMPLATE:` prefix tests
     - Section 4: Edge/stress tests (short prompts, mixed language, ambiguous)
     - Section 5: Verification checklist

     - All `AICourseGenerator.setApiKey(key)` → `GeminiClient.setApiKey(key)`


     - `package.json`, `src/course/version.ts` (SCHEMA_VERSION='1.0.0', SCHEMA_URL, SUPPORTED_VERSIONS)

4. Errors and Fixes:
   - **No new errors introduced**: Both `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` passed after all changes (only pre-existing failures: `course_schema_migration_test.dart` "Expected: '1.0.0'" and `widget_test.dart` Supabase init)

   - **Landing page auth approach**: Initially used `AuthDialog` popup, user asked "我本来的登录页面呢" — changed to `context.go('/login')` (Option A)

   - **Generic renderer viewport**: Bodies were invisible because they could drift outside configured xMin/xMax during simulation. Solved with `_computeViewport()` that dynamically expands viewport based on current body positions in state
   - **Block too small**: Default 320px leaves only ~150px canvas after control bar. Increased to 400px

33/33 tests ✓, 0 type errors across all packages. Phase 2 is complete.

---

**Phase 2 delivered.** Here's what was built:

**Editor core**
- `EditorLayout` — 3-panel layout (lesson nav | block canvas | property panel)  
- `EditorHeader` — course title, save status indicator, Save + Publish buttons
- `EditorPage` — hydrates Redux from remote course snapshot or bootstraps new course

**Block canvas (dnd-kit)**
- `BlockCanvas` — `DndContext` + `SortableContext` with vertical-only drag constraint  
- `SortableBlock` — drag handle, click-to-select, delete button  
- `BlockPreview` — read-only block summary with type-specific content snippet  
- `AddBlockMenu` — grouped popup (Content / Interactive / Quiz) to add any of the 13 block types

**Property panels (React Hook Form + Zod)**
- `TextPanel` — plain text ↔ richtext ops conversion (TipTap replaces in Phase 3)  
- `CodeBlockPanel` — language selector + code textarea  
- `MultipleChoicePanel` — question, dynamic options with correct-answer toggle, `useFieldArray`  
- `ImagePanel` — URL + live preview + alt text  
- `TrueFalsePanel` — statement + True/False radio  
- `InteractiveVisualPanel` — template selector + AI prompt  
- All panels sync to Redux on every keystroke via `watch()` subscription

**Auto-save (3 tiers)**
- 500ms debounce → localStorage (survives page refresh)  
- 4s debounce → remote Supabase (`lessons.content_json` per lesson)  
- Save button → `forceSave()` immediate flush  
- Publish → Zod strict validation first, then `forceSave()`, then `status = 'published'`

**Tests:** 13 builder + 20 schema = 33 total ✓

**To start locally:**
```bash
cp packages/builder/.env.example packages/builder/.env
# fill in your Supabase URL + anon key
cd packages/builder && pnpm dev
```

**Phase 3** will add: TipTap rich text, CodeMirror 6, remaining block property panels (fill-blank, matching, video, animation), lesson/page add-remove actions, and course metadata editing.

content.text:
不一定需要现在部署。解释一下背景：

**React Builder 是什么：** 课程作者用来创作课程的 Web 工具（替代原来的 Flutter Builder）。它是 SPA，需要托管在某个域名上，作者才能打开浏览器使用。

**为什么你问"帮我部署"可能只是误解：** 你之前说的那句话原文是：

> *"需要对着真实 Supabase 项目跑一次 pnpm db:types 才能生成——这是部署配置步骤：帮我部署"*

# Changelog

## [Unreleased] - 2026-03-17 (Builder↔Viewer Schema Alignment + Viewer Feature Parity)

### Summary
Multi-session batch of Builder↔Viewer alignment fixes and new Viewer capabilities.
Covers JSON key normalization (snake_case), Viewer auth resilience, graph matching, visibility gating, multi-select questions, video block playback, and a suite of smaller bug fixes across both apps and the Supabase backend.

### Added
- **Viewer: embedded video playback** — `VideoEmbedWidget` (3 files: conditional export / web HtmlElementView / non-web placeholder) in `Viewer/lib/widgets/`. `_toEmbedUrl()` converts YouTube watch links → `/embed/ID` and Vimeo links → `player.vimeo.com/video/ID`; direct URLs passed as-is. New `QuestionType.video` renders the player inside the lesson flow.
- **Viewer: multi-select questions** — new `QuestionType.multiChoice` with checkbox UI ("Select all that apply"); `correctIndices: Set<int>` tracks correct option positions; validation requires exact full match.
- **Viewer: graph-mode matching** — `matching` blocks with `nodes` + `edges` fields now build label→label pairs and reuse the existing list-matching drag UI instead of showing an error.
- **Viewer: visibility gating** — `visibility_rule: 'afterPreviousCorrect'` fully implemented: `_lastAnsweredCorrectly` tracked per answer; `_nextQuestion()` skips gated blocks when the previous answer was wrong.
- **Supabase: `publish_course` RPC v2** (`20260317000001_fix_publish_course_v2.sql`) — rewrote to only flip course status; removed join on the deleted `chapters` table and the unconditional `lessons.content_json` overwrite that was clearing Builder snapshots.

### Changed
- **Builder JSON snake_case normalization** — `Course.toJson()` now emits `schema_version`, `course_id`; `CourseMetadata.toJson()` emits `difficulty_level`, `estimated_minutes`; `CourseLesson.toJson()` emits `lesson_id`; `LessonPage.toJson()` emits `page_id`. All `fromJson()` methods accept both old camelCase and new snake_case keys for backward compatibility.
- **Builder schema migrator** (`course_schema_migrator.dart`) — reads `schema_version`/`schemaVersion`, `course_id`/`courseId`, `lesson_id`/`lessonId`; renames `difficulty` → `difficulty_level` and `estimatedMinutes` → `estimated_minutes` during migration; finalizes output with canonical snake_case keys.
- **Builder schema validator** (`course_schema_validator.dart`) — all field reads updated to accept dual-key form; validation paths use canonical snake_case names.
- **Builder `Block.toJson()`** — skips `_normalizeToSnakeCase()` for `InteractiveVisualContent` to prevent double conversion (camelCase spec must be preserved for Viewer).
- **Viewer auth resilience** (`Viewer/lib/services/supabase_service.dart`) — all auth methods (`signUp`, `signIn`, `signOut`, `signInWithGoogle`, `signInWithApple`) wrapped with `_withAuthTimeout<T>()` (30 s hard cap) and 3-attempt exponential backoff (900 ms → 1 800 ms → 2 500 ms).
- **Viewer `_parseCodeExecution`** — reads `source_code` first, falls back to `sourceCode` then `code` for compatibility.
- **Builder `updateProfile` calls** — `displayName:` parameter renamed to `username:` in `builder_settings_dialog.dart` and `profile_dialog.dart` to match the current `SupabaseService.updateProfile` signature.
- **Viewer `course_screen.dart`** — replaced `_chapters` / `_expandedChapters` state with `_lessons` matching the current data model; removed accordion expand logic.
- **Viewer `user_provider.dart`** — removed dead fields `_completedQuestions`, `_unlockedAchievements`, and the `_checkAndUpdateStreak` call.
- **Builder `property_panel.dart`** — removed unused `StorageService` import.

### Fixed
- `Builder/test/models_test.dart` — `Course JSON schema fields` test updated to assert `schema_version` and `course_id` keys (was `schemaVersion`/`courseId`).

### Validation
- `cd Builder && flutter analyze --no-pub` — 0 errors.
- `cd Builder && flutter test` — 130 pass, 1 pre-existing failure (`widget_test.dart` / Supabase init).
- `cd Viewer && flutter analyze --no-pub` — 0 issues.
- `cd Viewer && flutter test` — 10 pass, 0 failures.

---

## [Unreleased] - 2026-03-16 (Interactive Visual: Platform AI Key + Style Picker)

# Changelog

## [Unreleased] - 2026-03-19 (React Builder — Full Rewrite on `builder-react-rewrite`)

### Summary
Full rewrite of the Flutter Web Builder as a React/TypeScript pnpm monorepo under `packages/`.
Introduces `@primoria/schema` (Zod-based single source of truth for course JSON), `@primoria/db`
(Supabase generated types), and `@primoria/builder` (Vite 6 + React 19 + Redux Toolkit SPA).
Feature-complete with the Flutter Builder, plus course duplication, JSON import, block-style
editing, in-editor learner preview, and AI generation for Interactive Visual blocks.

### Added

#### `packages/schema` — `@primoria/schema`
- Zod schemas for all 13 block types (`text`, `image`, `code-block`, `code-playground`, `code-execution`, `function-flow`, `multiple-choice`, `fill-blank`, `true-false`, `matching`, `animation`, `interactive-visual`, `video`) and full course hierarchy (`Block → Page → Lesson → Course`).
- `migrateCourseJson()` — normalises all legacy key aliases (camelCase → snake_case, `pages` → `lessons`, block-type aliases, visibilityRule aliases).
- `parseCourse()` — strict Zod parse with informative error messages.
- Test fixtures: `FIXTURE_MINIMAL_COURSE`, `FIXTURE_ALL_BLOCKS_COURSE`, `FIXTURE_LEGACY_COURSE_RAW`.
- 20 Vitest tests covering all migration paths and schema validation.

#### `packages/db` — `@primoria/db`
- `database.generated.ts` generated from real Supabase project `rygafvlzzkvqhhenajzi` via `supabase gen types typescript`.
- `pnpm db:types` script added to both `packages/db/package.json` and root `package.json`.

#### `packages/builder` — `@primoria/builder`
- **Stack**: Vite 6, React 19, TypeScript strict, React Router v7, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query v5, Tailwind CSS v3, shadcn/Radix UI, React Hook Form + Zod, @dnd-kit, TipTap, CodeMirror 6.
- **Auth**: `LoginPage`, `RegisterPage`, `AuthCallbackPage`; GitHub/Google OAuth; `AuthProvider` bootstraps Supabase session → Redux on mount; `RequireAuth` / `RedirectIfAuth` route guards.
- **Dashboard**: course list, inline create, delete (confirm), duplicate (deep-copy lessons), import from JSON file (`parseCourse` + `migrateCourseJson`).
- **Editor layout**: 3-panel (224 px lesson nav | flex canvas | 288 px property panel); `EditorHeader` with undo/redo (⌘Z/⌘⇧Z), preview toggle, export JSON, Save, Publish.
- **Lesson/page management**: `LessonNav` — dnd-kit vertical sort, inline title edit, add/delete lesson & page.
- **Block canvas**: `BlockCanvas` — dnd-kit sort, per-block drag handle, duplicate, delete; `AddBlockMenu` grouped by category (Content / Interactive / Quiz).
- **Auto-save** (3-tier): 500 ms → localStorage; 4 s → Supabase upsert (courses + lessons, orphan cleanup); Save button → force flush.
- **Undo/redo**: `past[]`/`future[]` in Redux, MAX_HISTORY=50, Immer `current()` snapshot to prevent proxy aliasing.
- **Keyboard shortcuts**: ⌘Z undo, ⌘⇧Z/⌘Y redo, ⌘S save, ⌘D duplicate, Delete/Backspace remove block.
- **Publish**: full `CourseSchema.safeParse` validation before upsert; sets `status='published'`.
- **All 13 block property panels**: TextPanel (TipTap rich-text), CodeBlockPanel (CodeMirror 6, 6 languages), MultipleChoicePanel, TrueFalsePanel, FillBlankPanel, MatchingPanel, ImagePanel, VideoPanel (YouTube live preview), AnimationPanel, InteractiveVisualPanel, FunctionFlowPanel, MetadataPanel, CourseSettingsPanel.
- **Block style editor**: spacing (none/sm/md/lg), alignment (left/center/right), width/height inputs; dispatches `updateBlockStyle`.
- **Course settings panel**: theme light/dark, primaryColor (color picker + hex input), fontFamily with live preview; dispatches `updateSettings`.
- **Block settings**: visibilityRule select, requiredForProgress checkbox.
- **In-editor learner preview**: eye-icon toggle in header; `PreviewMode` renders all blocks via `BlockRenderer` (read-only renderers for all 13 types) in a centred 2xl container with amber preview banner.
- **AI generation for Interactive Visual**: "✨ Generate with AI" button in `InteractiveVisualPanel`; calls `supabase.functions.invoke('gemini-generate', { body: { prompt } })`; stores returned HTML as `generatedHtml` in block content.
- **38 Vitest tests** across editorSlice (CRUD, undo/redo, duplicate, blockSettings), route guards.

### Validation
- `pnpm typecheck` (workspace-wide) — 0 errors.
- `pnpm test` (workspace-wide) — 58 tests pass (20 schema + 38 builder).

# Changelog

## [Unreleased] - 2026-03-17 (Builder↔Viewer Schema Alignment + Viewer Feature Parity)

### Summary
Multi-session batch of Builder↔Viewer alignment fixes and new Viewer capabilities.
Covers JSON key normalization (snake_case), Viewer auth resilience, graph matching, visibility gating, multi-select questions, video block playback, and a suite of smaller bug fixes across both apps and the Supabase backend.

### Added
- **Viewer: embedded video playback** — `VideoEmbedWidget` (3 files: conditional export / web HtmlElementView / non-web placeholder) in `Viewer/lib/widgets/`. `_toEmbedUrl()` converts YouTube watch links → `/embed/ID` and Vimeo links → `player.vimeo.com/video/ID`; direct URLs passed as-is. New `QuestionType.video` renders the player inside the lesson flow.
- **Viewer: multi-select questions** — new `QuestionType.multiChoice` with checkbox UI ("Select all that apply"); `correctIndices: Set<int>` tracks correct option positions; validation requires exact full match.

lines: +Full rewrite of the Flutter Web Builder as a React/TypeScript pnpm monorepo under `packages/`.
+Introduces `@primoria/schema` (Zod-based single source of truth for course JSON), `@primoria/db`
+(Supabase generated types), and `@primoria/builder` (Vite 6 + React 19 + Redux Toolkit SPA).
+Feature-complete with the Flutter Builder, plus course duplication, JSON import, block-style
+editing, in-editor learner preview, and AI generation for Interactive Visual blocks.

+- Zod schemas for all 13 block types (`text`, `image`, `code-block`, `code-playground`, `code-execution`, `function-flow`, `multiple-choice`, `fill-blank`, `true-false`, `matching`, `animation`, `interactive-visual`, `video`) and full course hierarchy (`Block → Page → Lesson → Course`).
+- `migrateCourseJson()` — normalises all legacy key aliases (camelCase → snake_case, `pages` → `lessons`, block-type aliases, visibilityRule aliases).
+- `parseCourse()` — strict Zod parse with informative error messages.
+- 20 Vitest tests covering all migration paths and schema validation.
+- `database.generated.ts` generated from real Supabase project `rygafvlzzkvqhhenajzi` via `supabase gen types typescript`.
+- `pnpm db:types` script added to both `packages/db/package.json` and root `package.json`.
+- **Stack**: Vite 6, React 19, TypeScript strict, React Router v7, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query v5, Tailwind CSS v3, shadcn/Radix UI, React Hook Form + Zod, @dnd-kit, TipTap, CodeMirror 6.
+- **Auth**: `LoginPage`, `RegisterPage`, `AuthCallbackPage`; GitHub/Google OAuth; `AuthProvider` bootstraps Supabase session → Redux on mount; `RequireAuth` / `RedirectIfAuth` route guards.
+- **Dashboard**: course list, inline create, delete (confirm), duplicate (deep-copy lessons), import from JSON file (`parseCourse` + `migrateCourseJson`).
+- **Editor layout**: 3-panel (224 px lesson nav | flex canvas | 288 px property panel); `EditorHeader` with undo/redo (⌘Z/⌘⇧Z), preview toggle, export JSON, Save, Publish.
+- **Lesson/page management**: `LessonNav` — dnd-kit vertical sort, inline title edit, add/delete lesson & page.
+- **Block canvas**: `BlockCanvas` — dnd-kit sort, per-block drag handle, duplicate, delete; `AddBlockMenu` grouped by category (Content / Interactive / Quiz).
+- **Auto-save** (3-tier): 500 ms → localStorage; 4 s → Supabase upsert (courses + lessons, orphan cleanup); Save button → force flush.
+- **Undo/redo**: `past[]`/`future[]` in Redux, MAX_HISTORY=50, Immer `current()` snapshot to prevent proxy aliasing.
+- **Keyboard shortcuts**: ⌘Z undo, ⌘⇧Z/⌘Y redo, ⌘S save, ⌘D duplicate, Delete/Backspace remove block.

+- **All 13 block property panels**: TextPanel (TipTap rich-text), CodeBlockPanel (CodeMirror 6, 6 languages), MultipleChoicePanel, TrueFalsePanel, FillBlankPanel, MatchingPanel, ImagePanel, VideoPanel (YouTube live preview), AnimationPanel, InteractiveVisualPanel, FunctionFlowPanel, MetadataPanel, CourseSettingsPanel.
+- **Block style editor**: spacing (none/sm/md/lg), alignment (left/center/right), width/height inputs; dispatches `updateBlockStyle`.
+- **Course settings panel**: theme light/dark, primaryColor (color picker + hex input), fontFamily with live preview; dispatches `updateSettings`.

+- **In-editor learner preview**: eye-icon toggle in header; `PreviewMode` renders all blocks via `BlockRenderer` (read-only renderers for all 13 types) in a centred 2xl container with amber preview banner.

+- **AI generation for Interactive Visual**: "✨ Generate with AI" button in `InteractiveVisualPanel`; calls `supabase.functions.invoke('gemini-generate', { body: { prompt } })`; stores returned HTML as `generatedHtml` in block content.
+- **38 Vitest tests** across editorSlice (CRUD, undo/redo, duplicate, blockSettings), route guards.

Introduces a complete React/TypeScript rewrite of the Flutter Web Builder
under a pnpm workspace. Three new packages ship in this commit:

**@primoria/schema**
- Zod schemas for all 13 block types and full Course → Lesson → Page → Block hierarchy
- migrateCourseJson(): normalises all legacy key aliases (camelCase → snake_case, block-type aliases)
- parseCourse(): strict Zod parse with informative errors
- Test fixtures and 20 Vitest tests covering all migration paths

**@primoria/db**
- database.generated.ts generated from real Supabase project (rygafvlzzkvqhhenajzi)
- pnpm db:types script wired in package and root workspace

**@primoria/builder** (Vite 6 · React 19 · TypeScript strict)
- Auth: Login / Register / OAuth callback; RequireAuth / RedirectIfAuth guards; AuthProvider → Redux bootstrap
- Dashboard: course list, create, delete, duplicate (deep-copy lessons), import from JSON
- Editor: 3-panel layout (LessonNav · BlockCanvas · PropertyPanel); EditorHeader with undo/redo, preview toggle, export, Save, Publish
- Block canvas: dnd-kit vertical sort, drag handle, duplicate, delete, AddBlockMenu (13 types, 3 categories)
- All 13 block property panels (TipTap rich-text, CodeMirror 6, RHF forms, YouTube live preview, AI generation)
- BlockStyleEditor (spacing / alignment / width / height), CourseSettingsPanel (theme / color / font)
- Auto-save: 500 ms → localStorage · 4 s → Supabase upsert · force flush on Save button
- Undo/redo: past[]/future[] in Redux, Immer current() snapshots, MAX_HISTORY=50
- Keyboard shortcuts: ⌘Z · ⌘⇧Z · ⌘S · ⌘D · Delete
- Learner preview mode: BlockRenderer (read-only, all 13 types) + PreviewMode container
- AI generation for Interactive Visual: calls gemini-generate Edge Function, stores generatedHtml
- 38 Vitest tests (editorSlice CRUD/undo/duplicate/settings, route guards)
- 0 TypeScript errors (pnpm typecheck workspace-wide)

docs: changelog + todo updated to reflect completed React migration work

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
